R689.note: Canonicalizes base with toRealPath, rejects absolute/NUL, normalizes and re-canonicalizes the candidate with Path.startsWith containment, opens only the checked path; fileName is reassigned to the canonical path before the success message despite the write-up claiming parity, but for an absolute non-symlinked TESTFILES_DIR the printed string is identical.

R690.note: Keeps the base64+serialize wire format and passes ['allowed_classes' => false] so no object can be instantiated; is_array fallback to ['items' => []] matches the contract for empty/invalid cookies and legitimate array carts return unchanged.

R691.note: Widget derives from enable_shared_from_this, lambda captures self = shared_from_this(), and handleRequest uses make_shared so the precondition holds; the queued task now owns the Widget until runPending drains, no other observable change.

R692.note: Replaces string.Format with a @ownerName placeholder bound via SqlParameter; same single DELETE, same row-count branching.

R693.note: Moves to pool.execute with a ? placeholder and bound [userId] so the value is a server-side prepared parameter; result shape and error handling unchanged.

R694.note: Wraps both tainted params in HTML::Entities encode_entities at the element-text insertion points; static badge and markup untouched.

R695.note: Uses the JNDI filterArgs overload with a {0} placeholder so the provider escapes the value per RFC 4515; new SearchControls() is the documented equivalent of the original null cons.

R696.note: jwt.decode replaced by jwt.verify with the secret and algorithms pinned to HS256; the new JWT_SECRET requirement and startup throw are stated plainly and are inherent to adding verification, HS256 assumption is disclosed.

R697.note: Fixing the env entry name closes attacker control of the variable and the regex blocks a Shellshock-shaped value, but the added allowlist (which excludes '=') and the changed variable name reject or reshape header values the original passed through as a NAME=VALUE entry, a restriction the original did not have.

R698.note: Swapping to fast-xml-parser with processEntities:false removes any external-entity fetch, but doc?.order?.id only matches a root <order> whereas //order/id matched at any depth, processEntities:false also leaves & and friends undecoded in the id (libxmljs .text() decoded them), and an <id> with attributes becomes '[object Object]'; only the structural assumption is stated and not accurately.

R699.note: Drops the cached Task& and re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] after push_back; order of completed/follow-up/priority writes and their values are unchanged.

R700.note: keyFunc asserts *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC and ParseWithClaims gets WithValidMethods(["HS256"]), closing algorithm confusion; the HS256 pin is stated plainly and matches a single shared-secret service (HS384/512 tokens, if any were ever issued, would now be rejected).
